1. Ordinan ini bolehlah dinamakan Ordinan Darurat  (Kuasa-Kuasa Perlu)
(No. 3) (Pembatalan) 2022.

Pembatalan

2. Ordinan Darurat (Kuasa-Kuasa Perlu) (No. 3) 2020 [P.U. (A) 359/2020] dibatalkan.

DIMASYHURKAN di Istana Negara BETA di Kuala Lumpur, Ibu Kota Persekutuan
pada enam hari bulan Oktober, dua ribu dua puluh dua.

AL-SULTAN ABDULLAH RI'AYATUDDIN AL-MUSTAFA BILLAH SHAH IBNI
ALMARHUM SULTAN HAJI AHMAD SHAH AL-MUSTA'IN BILLAH
Yang di-Pertuan Agong

[Akan dibentangkan di Parlimen menurut Fasal (3) Perkara 150
Perlembagaan Persekutuan]

EMERGENCY (ESSENTIAL POWERS) (NO. 3)
(REVOCATION) ORDINANCE 2022

An Ordinance promulgated by the Yang di -Pertuan Agong pursuant to Clause (2 B)
of Article 150 of the Federal Constitution.

                                            [6 October 2022]

WHEREAS by reason of a grave emergency threatening the security, economic life
and public order of  a part of  the Federation  namely the State Constituency
of N.66 Bugaya, Sabah  arising from the epidemic of an infectious  disease,
namely Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID -19), a Proclamation of Emergency  (No. 3 )
[P.U. (A) 358/2020] has been issued by the Yang di -Pertuan Agong under Clause (1)
of Article 150 of t he Federal Constitution on  the twelfth day of December,
two thousand twenty:

 AND WHEREAS the Yang di -Pertuan Agong is satisfied that  the need for
the Emergency (Essential Powers) ( No. 3 ) Ordinance 2020 [P.U. (A) 3 59/2020]
promulgated under the Proclamation of Emergency (No. 3 ) has ended and  an action
to revoke the Emergency Ordinance is required:

IT IS HEREBY PROMULGATED AN ORDINANCE by the Yang di -Pertuan Agong
pursuant to Clause (2B) of Article 150 of the Federal Constitution as follows:
